Response: Taking into consideration the possibility of future loss, the project as it is now designed represents a balance between this possibility and the present needs of the area and its inhabatants. As the project develops and additional techniques and methods are developed through experience, to the extent possible, HUD will encourage the employment of such measures. (e.g. development of floodproofing measures and revision of building and housing codes.)

i. Chairman of the Housing Committee, Joseph E.G. Grottenthaler
Comment: Concerned with the problems of housing -- would like to see massive help emerging form Federal and state sources to energize citizen efforts.
Response: The project represents aid to housing in the form redevelopment general up grading of neighborhoods. It does not, nor is intended to, replace other housing programs sponsored by other governmental units or programs.
